rules.selection: max in-sample t-stat among configs with >= min trades and an average >= +0.10% a trade (C1)
rules.pass: OOS (C1): trades >= 50, average >= +0.10% a trade (2% of the account at 20x), profit factor > 1

C1.name: C1 base: spread $0.40, slippage $0.10 a side, commission $0.035/oz a side (intraday: no financing)

C2.name: C2 harsh: spread $0.50, slippage $0.25 a side, commission $0.05/oz a side

C3.name: C3 measured: Dukascopy's quoted spread in the entry and exit hours + C1 slippage and commission
